title: Function Health locations
description: Left: a serif heading half in italic terracotta, a lead paragraph, a bold label and a pill zip-code field with a solid Submit pill. Right: outlined rounded stat cards: a tall one with a huge light figure over a bar-chart slot, one with a dot-map slot behind its figure, and a short wide one with a van icon. On phones the cards stack under the form.
notes: the chart and map are media slots
